notes: FRED/OECD-MEI monthly Canada 10Y government bond yield — a monthly AVERAGE of the daily series, so the comparable coarsening of the daily BoC primary is the mean, not the month-end value. Measured by the Phase 0 survey over a 306-month overlap: mean gives max|diff| 0.0350 (mean 0.0002) and classifies SAME_SERIES, while end-of-period gives 0.4332 and classifies DIFFERENT. This is a genuine single construction observed at two cadences — distinct from the CPI case (owner decision 2026-07-30), where YoY-of-annual-average and mean-of-monthly-YoY are different constructions and are recorded separately. Without this row the CAN_GOV_10Y seam is refused as cross-cadence and the column loses 46 years of history (FRED reaches 1955-01, BoC starts 2001-01) — confirmed on the 2026-07-30 run, where CAN_GOV_10Y was the only one of the five splice candidates not to fire. See forward_plan §2.C C16.1.
